messages:
Aria: quick mock in Figma for compact tool-call rows in playground run history — trying single-line signature pill + tiny inline preview. https://figma.redwood/mini-row-v1 :mag:
Marco: looks promising. couple constraints: keyboard focus order, and visible focus styles at small row heights.
Devon: agree. SR copy idea: "Tool call, summarize: translate_snippet, collapsed, 2 fields" then read fields on demand. keep it terse.
Aria: copy question — use middle dot 'translate_snippet \u00b7 45ms' or em dash?
Marco: middle dot wins for density. also ellipsize long names and provide tooltip + SR full name on focus.
Devon: accessibility nit: actions must not be hover-only. 'Copy signature' should be keyboard-focusable but can be visually hidden until focus.
Aria: added tiny JSON inline preview in mock: ```json
{"name":"translate_snippet","params":{"text":"Hola","lang":"en"}}
```
Marco: layout note: row height 46px to balance ops' compact ask and readability. test with 2x focus ring thickness and high contrast header text.
Devon: microcopy: use 'View full output' for the expand action (more user-friendly than 'Expand schema'). ensure aria-expanded toggles.
design-bot: Figma updated: https://figma.redwood/mini-row-v1 (v4) — comments cleared.
Aria: thanks all — I'll iterate and drop PNGs later today. :sparkles:
